first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The adult man in the image-left foreground, with brown side-parted hair and a thin mustache, wearing a purple jacket with red piping, a white shirt, and a black bow tie, and holding a note and pen.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The young man behind and to the image-right of Person A, wearing a dark purple stand-collar uniform and a matching cylindrical hat with two lines of gold lettering on the front.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The reddish-brown carpet runner in the lobby passageway, with light-colored longitudinal bands and border lines visible in the final frame.

entities.name: large potted palm
entities.identification: The tall plant with dark green pinnate leaves located behind Person A and Person B in the earlier portion.

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light warm-pink wall in the background, with light-colored outlines, rectangular sections, and arched areas.

entities.name: golden-brown stone-faced column
entities.identification: The tall column surface with irregular golden-yellow and brown textures and dark vertical dividing lines.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights
entities.identification: The collection of warm-white light fixtures in the upper part of the lobby and on the rear wall, including globe shades, small wall lights, and bulbs arranged along the edges of the arches.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The group of background people other than Person A and Person B, including the person in a long reddish-brown garment on the image-right in the final portion and people in the distance near the center.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The floor outside the red patterned carpet, with repeating light and dark geometric patterns.

entities.name: round-framed wall decoration
entities.identification: The wall decoration on the column surface with a light-gold curved frame edge and a pale, bright interior, whose projection is nearly a vertical oval in the more complete view.
